CodeQL query that flags `memcpy` calls that could be rewritten as assignments.

# Purpose
This CodeQL query detects calls to `memcpy` and related functions where the source and destination arguments have the same pointer type and the copy size matches the size of the pointed-to type. It excludes array pointer types, specific named types such as `fd_txn_p` and `fd_hash`, macro expansions, and the vendored `cJSON.c` file to avoid unsafe or unnecessary changes. When the pattern matches, the query reports that the call can be rewritten as an assignment statement, which improves type safety and reduces the risk of copy errors.
